legal_local_body: Your selected files, device name, and preferences are processed locally. LimLink requires no account, contains no ads or analytics tracking, and does not upload files to the developer’s servers.
legal_discovery_body: Local network participants can see device names, types, addresses, and public identity fingerprints. After encryption, recipients see file names and sizes. Bound devices receive automatically; others approve each file.
usage_sharing_body: Share only files you have the right to share. The initiator chooses a device and clicks Bind, then the recipient accepts; both then receive automatically. Names can be changed, so choose carefully.
legal_binding_body: Binding records are stored only on this device. Valid bindings allow automatic reception while LimLink is running on both devices; unbound or incomplete bindings require per-file acceptance. Unbinding in Settings stops future automatic reception on this device. It does not recall saved files or cancel an already accepted transfer. Device names do not prove ownership or identity.
legal_storage_body: Received files are saved in Downloads or your chosen folder and remain after restarting. Identity, bindings, preferences, recent transfers and diagnostic logs are stored in your local Windows user profile; diagnostic logs are not uploaded automatically. Deleting a received file from the recent list requests Recycle Bin deletion where supported; recoverability depends on the storage location and Windows settings. Removing only a list entry does not delete the file.
legal_notifications_body: Windows firewall and notification settings control local network access and notifications. Notifications may show device and file names; manage notification previews in Windows settings.
legal_support_body: For usage or privacy questions, contact the developer at the email below. Do not send file contents, keys or private logs when requesting support. These documents are available fully offline.
usage_about_body: LimLink transfers files directly on the same local network without a developer-operated file relay. These offline instructions explain current features and usage. They do not create a separate custom end user license agreement or restrict rights granted by applicable law.
usage_transfer_body: Both devices must be on the same local network with LimLink running during transfer. Windows can queue several files and send them to several selected devices. Each file can be up to 5 GB (5,000,000,000 bytes). Ensure the receiving device has enough free space, verify completion and keep needed backups before deleting originals.
usage_privacy_body: Read the Privacy Policy in Settings for local discovery, automatic reception, storage and diagnostics.
legal_operator: Operated by: 杭州浮点极限科技有限公司

usage_liability_title: 8. Liability and protection of your rights
usage_liability_body:
We are liable for the app and service in accordance with the law, and do not use “free of charge”, “direct local-network transfer” or blanket disclaimers to escape statutory obligations. Claims arising from product quality, consumer protection, personal information protection or other applicable law will be handled in accordance with the law.

Both parties should take reasonable steps to avoid and reduce losses, for example by verifying the receiving device, keeping devices secure, checking transfer results and backing up important files. Liability for situations such as network or system failures is determined by the specific facts and applicable law, and is not shifted wholesale to the user by this document.

This document does not exclude or limit liability for intent, gross negligence, personal injury or any other liability that by law cannot be excluded or limited, nor does it affect the warranties, remedies and complaint rights you have by law.

auto_save_images_hint: A separate copy is saved to Pictures/LimLink after verification. Removing history or the download does not remove this copy.
legal_preview_storage: File previews run locally using native image, PDF, media and text components; previews do not fetch document web resources. With automatic image saving enabled, verified received images are also copied to Pictures/LimLink. This creates a separate local copy and photo-export record. Turning this off stops future automatic copies. Removing a download or history entry does not remove the Pictures copy. Open With and Photos hand the selected file to the Windows application you choose; that application has its own privacy settings.
